unresolved_mappings.title: Microdeletion and Other Recognizable Genetic Syndromes (22q11.2/DiGeorge, Prader-Willi, Angelman, Noonan, CHARGE)
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective is titled for any of these individual syndromes; nearest evidence (36, Genetic concerns) covers only the general chromosomal/non-Mendelian causal_conditions category, not these named syndromes specifically.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds a dedicated microdeletion/dysmorphism-syndrome objective; retain given high clinical-recognition yield.

unresolved_mappings.title: Familial Cancer Syndromes
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective addresses hereditary cancer predisposition syndromes; nearest evidence (36, Genetic concerns) names only 'cancer' generically under polygenic/multifactorial postnatal environmental influences, not monogenic hereditary cancer syndromes.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit alongside chapter GY's/GS's/G's existing cancer-syndrome content during the global cross-chapter overlap audit; retain given clinical importance for genetics-referral triggers regardless of registry gap.

unresolved_mappings.title: Wilson Disease; Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective addresses either condition by name; nearest evidence (36, Genetic concerns) covers only the generic 'Monogenic (single gene mutations)' causal_conditions category.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds objectives for these specific conditions; both retained as DIRECT given their status as classic, high-yield single-gene disorders in Canadian medical curricula.
